analysis:
Integration across all 18 units: the PR is documentation, a benchmark harness, and tests. Docs changed: changelog.d/qwen-mtp-concurrent-decode.md, docs/architecture/inference.md (head ~1370-1382), docs/developer/test.md (line 494), docs/provider/cli-reference.md (line 564 and 1208-1209), and docs/reference/configuration.md (401-402). Code added: provider-swift/Sources/ProviderBenchmark/RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark.swift and its report, the refactor of shared RuntimeGenerationBenchmark helpers, and the new --runtime-concurrency/--runtime-stagger options in BenchmarkCommand.swift. Tests added: RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmarkTests.swift.

I found no security regression. The benchmark is an operator-invoked local CLI path. It touches no coordinator WebSocket (TB-002), attestation or App Attest authorization (TB-011), or key custody. It keeps prefix caches off through the shared prefixCacheDisabledEnvironment and per-request prefixCacheEnabled:false, so the T-041 SSD tier posture (HMAC names, 30-minute TTL, salt scoping, KEK purge) is unchanged. Input is bounded: batch sizes 1..64, maxTokens <=131072, prompt <=4 MiB, with argument conflicts rejected before the model loads. Weight-hash verification is retained and the container is released on mismatch (T-012/T-027). Reports hold prompt and token hashes and timings for operator-supplied public prompts, and no consumer data. The new env switches DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CHAINED and DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CARRY are performance rollback toggles that are not forwarded to LaunchAgents, so they add no privilege boundary.

Unverified (outside supplied evidence): the Swift MTP implementation (EngineLoopV2+MTPOrdinaryHistory.swift, MTPContractsV2.swift) is not in the PR units I saw. Per-request isolation of the chained assistant history and carry, clearing on cancel or retire (T-028, T-010), and consistency with cacheSalt and SSD checkpoints (T-041) cannot be checked here. Also unverified: the SPI-gated Benchmarking exposure in release products, the head lines 1208-1209 in cli-reference.md, and the replayed integration source, which omitted 59 units. These are open questions, not findings.
